evidence.quoteEn: Novels take too long, and some members might fall behind.

questions.promptVi: Điều gì có thể xảy ra nếu chọn đọc tiểu thuyết?

segments.textEn: Lan, we should decide what kind of book our library reading club should start with. Why do you think short stories are better than novels for our first meeting?
I think short stories are much better because everyone can finish reading them quickly before they come. Novels take too long, and some members might fall behind.
That makes sense. If the text is short, busy students will not feel stressed, and we will have more time to talk about the main ideas during the session.
